# Test Case 2: Tools Property Optional

## Input
- File: `packages/opencode/src/session/activity-template.ts`
- Search patterns:
  - `tools: TaskToolsSchema.optional()`
  - `tools: TaskToolsSchema` + `default`

## Expected Output
- `hasOptionalTools: true` - TaskSchema has optional tools property
- `hasToolsDefault: true` - CreateOptions has tools with defaults

## Vessel Architecture Context
Tools must be optional because:
- Vessels may have different tool sets
- Tasks can run anywhere tools are available
- Pre-flight checks validate tool availability
- Empty defaults allow tasks without specific tool requirements
